expected.description: Show the ledger balance as read-only derived state with an explicit immutable or locked cue; do not provide a balance field, direct-save control, or any direct ledger editing affordance.
Keep corrections as proposals that require the distinct approval flow; never imply that editing or saving the displayed balance mutates existing ledger rows.
Preserve the supplied Accounting workbench layout, typography, palette, content hierarchy, right rail, documents, evidence intake, reconciliation, close-period, setup, and unrelated controls.

prompts: Revise the supplied Accounting workbench while preserving its immutable ledger contract. The ledger balance is derived, read-only state. Existing entries are never edited: posting and approved corrections append versioned ledger rows, while submitting a correction proposal does not change the ledger. Preserve the baseline layout and all unrelated panels.

notes: Frontend source: AccountingWorkbenchBlock renders ledgerAmountMinor as a Heading beside 'Current immutable balance'; its ledger-version input only selects an immutable historical snapshot, and historical correction fields are disabled.

Backend source: posting and approval insert new accounting_ledger rows; submitting a correction proposal explicitly does not change the ledger; approved correction appends one signed successor at a new ledger version.

preserve: Preserve the complete 1536x1024 Accounting workbench composition, typography, white and navy visual language, spacing, documents table, evidence-document form, reconciliation card, close-period card, applied-context rail, pending-corrections rail, correction-proposal rail, and accounting-setup rail.
Preserve all unrelated labels, values, badges, fields, buttons, and panel positions from the supplied baseline.
change: Keep the ledger balance read-only and visibly immutable or locked, with no editable balance field and no direct balance-save control.
